report:
Reviewed the complete body_interfaces claim, the ordinary fns.rs association, both associated tests, and captured helper context. Independently verified exact current byte equality with the historical implementation_sources and both test_sources; the historical rationale remains appropriately limited to one demonstrated case and explicit deferred coverage.

The claim permits own source/signature and demanded signatures, fields, associated items, impl headers, metadata facts and solver results, prohibits callee/sibling body reads, and requires caller result and execution stability after callee-body-only edits. LocalFnSym::body reads self.sig/self.cst, establishes its own resolver, imports signature types and parameter environment, binds parameters, checks its own body, coerces its result, finalizes inference and returns CheckedBody. Owner opening uses trait/impl signatures. This supplies concrete implementation structure; it is not a proof that every transitive expression-checking path obeys the dependency restriction.

The ordinary clone_method_body_has_a_narrow_reusable_semantic_query_trace test exercises a field access and clone call. Its assertions specify the demanded associated-item/function/trait signature calls, exclude body-labelled metadata calls, require the requested body query to execute cold, and require no metadata calls or body-query execution warm. Captured tracing/record helpers retain calls, take_query_log drains the log, and force_db_method actually requests the named local method body, asserts no diagnostics, and panics if absent; setup_root_module constructs and parses the fixture. These assertions substantiate narrow cold/warm interface reuse, not callee-edit stability or universal sibling isolation.

The second test, sage_meta::todo::symbols_body_interfaces, explicitly defers the full callee-body edit matrix and sibling-body trace cases. Its empty body is not behavioral evidence. This deferral still accounts for the unverified general prohibition and edit invariance: completion requires fixtures mutating only callee bodies, asserting unchanged caller results and absence of caller execution, plus sibling isolation traces across relevant call forms. No N/A entries exist. The accepted TODO remains deferred; this report does not assert complete implementation or coverage.

Validation: source inspection, exact historical byte comparisons, and review start/read/record commands only; no behavioral tests or workspace build executed by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and root build are separate baseline execution, not evidence that the deferred matrix ran. No source edits requested.
